request_settings.reasoning_control_note: Gemma 4 and Qwen3.8 use their default provider reasoning behavior. No unverified reasoning-control request field is sent.
request_settings.returned_model_policy: require exact equality with the requested model ID; missing or different returned_model_id halts after the charged event is durably reconciled

qwen38_usage_transport_fix.trigger_error: streaming response ended without usage chunk

fixed_vs_r2: Only Qwen3.8 transport changes from stream true to an ordinary non-streaming response. Its model ID, prompt, seed, sampling, reasoning classification, 4096-token floor, context ceiling, prices, and every analysis gate remain unchanged. Gemma 4 remains streaming.

uncertain_spend_tolerance.trigger_error: run-local uncertain spend exceeds the frozen ceiling

fixed_vs_r3: Only the uncertain-spend policy changes: a live run-local ledger may now carry terminal unknown_charge events whose reserved cost is held as uncertain spend, counted fully against the 60 USD aggregate cap and bounded by the 1.00 USD per-run ceiling above; reaching the ceiling halts the run fail-closed for owner review and never auto-chains a successor. Every token limit, transport pin, price input, model ID, seed, prompt, and analysis gate is unchanged from r3.
fixed_vs_r4: Only the roster substitution changes: the delisted google/gemma-3n-E4B-it entries are replaced by Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B, which renders thinking-on by default (screening record phase3_v3_qwen35_9b_screening_2026-08-25) and therefore joins the reasoning roster with the 4096-token floor and non-streaming transport. Every other limit, pin, and the amendment-3 uncertain-spend tolerance are unchanged from r4.
fixed_vs_r5: Only the per-run uncertain-spend ceiling changes, from 1.00 to 2.50 USD, selected by the owner from the decision menu after the 2026-08-26 Qwen3.8 timeout burst tripped the 1.00 ceiling, and ratified by the bound Codex consult (flat ceiling preferred over a per-model sub-bound). Uncertain spend still counts fully against the 60 USD aggregate cap. Every other limit, pin, and policy is unchanged from r5.
